description.en: Shorthand for ShowTutorialEx with the voice-over sound fixed to "str_005" and _decide fixed to true. Note: its own _strm argument is accepted but not actually used.
Accepted but not used — the voice-over is always "str_005" regardless of this argument.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a tutorial image panel
ShowTutorial2("tt1072", 1);
